outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then closes the gripper around it (frames 60–100, wrist_image). The drawer progressively moves outward (frames 120–180, image and left_ego_image), and remains visibly open after the gripper releases and withdraws (frames 190–225, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or disturbance of unrelated tabletop objects is visibly established.
